UAE Representative Office

  1. Home
  2. /Trust Center
  3. /UAE Representative Office

WINPROFX operates a UAE representative office under the business name WINPROFX LTD - DUBAI BRANCH - REP. OFFICE. The office is registered under Dubai Professional License No. 1423678 with license activity listed as Representative Office.

The UAE representative office provides a local business presence for WINPROFX in the United Arab Emirates. It supports information sharing, support coordination, brand representation, and client or partner communication where permitted under the representative office license scope.

Role of a Representative Office

A representative office is a type of business registration that allows a foreign company to establish a local presence for limited activities such as marketing, liaison, and coordination. It is not the same as a full trading license or a financial services broker license.

  • Local business presence and brand representation in the UAE
  • Information and support coordination for clients and partners
  • Communication through official WINPROFX channels where permitted
  • Connection to the official UAE regional domain at winprofx.ae

Important Clarification

This Dubai Professional License lists the activity as Representative Office. A representative office license is different from a financial services broker license. Any financial services, forex broker, or CFD broker regulatory authorization should be verified separately through official regulatory records.

The Saint Lucia incorporation document confirms the legal formation of Winprofx Ltd. The Dubai Professional License confirms the Dubai branch / representative office registration and activity as a Representative Office. These documents should not be confused with a financial services broker license, forex broker license, CFD broker license, or investment services authorization unless separate regulator-issued financial services license details are published and verified.

Financial regulatory license details are pending compliance verification and will be updated only after verification through official regulator records.

User Verification Guidance

Before registering, logging in, depositing funds, or sharing personal information, users should verify:

  • The exact website domain (winprofx.org, winprofx.com, or winprofx.ae)
  • The license business name matches WINPROFX LTD - DUBAI BRANCH - REP. OFFICE
  • Official support channels (support@winprofx.com and the Contact page)
  • Client portal URL: https://my.winprofx.org/
  • Partner portal URL: https://partner.winprofx.org/
